title.zh: Arbitrum Replaces Timeboost With Per-Transaction Priority Auctions
title.en: Arbitrum Replaces Timeboost With Per-Transaction Priority Auctions

current_state.zh: Arbitrum is replacing its Timeboost mechanism with per-transaction priority auctions, with priority fees and paid Fast Feed subscriptions directing 97% of proceeds to the DAO treasury and 3% to the Arbitrum Developer Guild.
current_state.en: Arbitrum is replacing its Timeboost mechanism with per-transaction priority auctions, with priority fees and paid Fast Feed subscriptions directing 97% of proceeds to the DAO treasury and 3% to the Arbitrum Developer Guild.
